# statusdrift_collaborator (Data Source)

Fetches a single organization member by ID or email. Use this to look up member IDs for on-call schedules and policies.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Look up a member by email for use in on-call schedules
data "statusdrift_collaborator" "alice" {
  email = "alice@example.com"
}

resource "statusdrift_on_call_schedule" "primary" {
  name              = "Primary On-Call"
  timezone          = "UTC"
  frequency         = "weekly"
  rotation_interval = 1
  starts_at         = "2025-01-01T00:00:00Z"
  participant_ids   = [data.statusdrift_collaborator.alice.id]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `email` (String) The email address of the organization member.
- `id` (Number) The ID of the organization member.

### Read-Only

- `name` (String) The full name of the organization member.
- `role` (String) The organization role (owner, admin, global_view, global_editor, global_communication, member).
- `status` (String) The membership status (pending, accepted).
